meta.title: Work one action at a time. Stop switching tasks.
meta.description: EXECUTAR shows your one eligible next action and only accepts "done" with evidence attached. Keep going from the app, WhatsApp, email, the Copilot, or the Scanner.

features.description: Five real capabilities, one shared state — nothing here is a mockup.

items.title: Copilot

items.title: Mapa-OS

items.title: Scanner

items.title: Routines & automations

items.title: Work one action

items.title: Keep one state

items.title: Confirm before automating

faq.title: Questions worth answering directly
faq.description: If something here doesn't answer your question, reach out — we'd rather explain it once than leave it vague.

items.question: What is EXECUTAR, in one sentence?
items.answer: One queue holding your next eligible action — reachable from the app, WhatsApp, email, the Copilot, MCP, or a phone camera pointed at a physical symbol.

items.question: Why only one action at a time?
items.answer: Switching tasks has a real cost. Showing one removes the "what should I do now" decision and cuts the rework of picking back up something you left half-done.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Solo and Pro bill per executor, monthly or annually. Business bills per workspace with 5 seats included. See the pricing page for current figures — they're marked PROPOSED because they haven't been published as final commercial terms yet.

items.question: Does my data stay in sync across channels?
items.answer: Yes. There's one canonical store. WhatsApp, email, the Copilot, and MCP all read and write through it — none of them holds a competing version of your state.

items.question: Do I need to code anything to use the Scanner?
items.answer: No. Install the mobile app, point the camera at the symbol, done — recognition runs on-device, no cloud round-trip per frame.
